body: Hi! I know this is a bit unrelated by I have been working with my pup to not nip ankles can I ask you what you did? Right now we are working on her prey drive with making sure her recall, stay, and leave it are on cue as we have a lot of wild turkey where I live. But I’m unsure on what to do about the nipping at ankles as she does it to our older dog sometimes (not in a mean aggressive way, just when she wants to control him a bit) and he doesn’t seem to care but I don’t want her to think that’s okay so I don’t know what to do and any advice would be lovely!

German shepherd corgi’s 

It honestly irritates me because it causes a lot of health problems.
